neon_pop_hook.caption: neon synth pop, 120 bpm, bright lead vocal, pulsing bass, glossy drums, wide chorus harmonies
neon_pop_hook.lyrics:
[verse]
we found sparks in the city rain
counted seconds by the train
[chorus]
light it up and let it go
we are brighter than we know

indie_rock_room.caption: indie rock band in a small live room, 94 bpm, jangly guitars, warm bass, dry snare, intimate vocal
indie_rock_room.lyrics:
[verse]
there is dust on the windowsill
and a song we never played
[chorus]
turn the corner, hold it still
we are not so far away

instrumental_bossa.caption: instrumental bossa nova trio, nylon guitar, upright bass, soft shaker, mellow piano fills, sunny cafe ambience
